rules: Only styles/components/sidebar.css may style app-sidebar-* selectors.
Sidebar rows use one canonical row primitive with depth data attributes.
Only the scroll viewport may scroll; brand and support remain fixed.
No hover translation, gradient, nested card or focus ring is allowed.
Collapsed sidebar and flyout code must not return while collapse remains disabled.
The RTL application sidebar is physically anchored with right: 0 and left: auto; logical inline-end anchoring is forbidden.
The mobile close control is not rendered in desktop DOM; visibility must not depend on CSS alone.
Sidebar width is canonical across StyleContext, layout reservation and settings: 196px to 280px, default 272px.
Sidebar search uses an explicit three-column grid; the search icon is the physical left column and never overlays input text.
Sidebar search must not use data-sidebar-search-input or runtime element.style important resets.
